• Virgin Atlantic — Onboard connectivity satisfaction has increased by more than 40 points, with Starlink also helping attract new Flying Club members

• airBaltic — Net Promoter Scores are approximately 9 points higher on Starlink-equipped flights

• ZIPAIR — Passenger revenue grew 12.3% YoY, with JAL highlighting fleetwide Starlink connectivity alongside flexible pricing

Starlink has become a real competitive advantage, improving the passenger experience, strengthening customer loyalty, and giving people another reason to choose which airline they fly with

The future of in-flight connectivity is becoming a major part of how airlines compete
